mapper.select:
select goods.id as goodsId, goods.name as goodsName, goods.introduce, goods.images, goods.price, goods.stock, goods.sort_introduce, goods.class_id as classId, class.name as className, goods.status, count(orders.id) as goodsOrderCount from goods as goods inner join class as class on class.id = goods.class_id left join orders as orders on orders.goods_id = goods.id where goods.status=0
and class.id=#{goodsPageAppVto.categorySecond}
and goods.name like CONCAT('%',#{goodsPageAppVto.name},'%')
group by goods.id

select goods.id as goodsId, goods.name as goodsName, goods.introduce, goods.images, goods.price, goods.stock, goods.sort_introduce, goods.class_id as classId, class.name as className, goods.status, count(orders.id) as goodsOrderCount from goods as goods inner join class as class on class.id = goods.class_id left join orders as orders on orders.goods_id = goods.id where goods.id = #{goodsId} group by goods.id
